install: touch ~/.bashrc && sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; CHROME="$(command -v google-chrome || command -v google-chrome-stable || command -v chromium || command -v chromium-browser || true)"; if [ -n "$CHROME" ]; then grep -qxF "export CHROMIUM_BIN=$CHROME" ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || echo "export CHROMIUM_BIN=$CHROME" >> ~/.bashrc; fi; if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; elif [ -f package.json ]; then npm install --no-audit --no-fund; fi
